title: Earliest known Oldowan artifacts at >2.58 Ma from Ledi-Geraru, Ethiopia, highlight early technological diversity
lineage: The full primary study was inspected, but the retained cache is a source-identified researcher paraphrase. Precise earliest Oldowan chronology has attracted critique; no origin claim is needed here.
